references.text: David acknowledges his sin and asks for cleansing, which mirrors Judas's confession of sin by betraying innocent blood
Describes the ways of the wicked as unjust, including the shedding of innocent blood, something Judas realizes he has participated in
Warning against accepting bribes to shed innocent blood, which can be seen as related to Judas's actions
Lists the shedding of innocent blood as one of the things the Lord hates, which reflects Judas's remorse
